summary: Vitalik 发布更新后的以太坊 strawmap，来自两周前柏林研究者会议，承接 4 月在 Svalbard 与客户端团队的讨论。Barnabé 对比 2 月版本：quick slots 从 Hegotá 推迟到 J*，进一步缩短 slot 从 K* 推到 L*，decoupled consensus 列入 I*。nero_eth 概括重点为 UX（更短 slot、frame 交易、更快最终性、隐私）、扩容和后量子。dankrad 认为 3 到 4 年太慢，借助 LLM 有望约 1 年完成。

items.title: Vitalik：更新后的 strawmap
items.note: 00:28，两周前研究者在柏林继续规划协议长期路线，延续 4 月在 Svalbard 与客户端团队的讨论。
items.note_en: 00:28; two weeks earlier researchers met in Berlin to continue charting the protocol's long-term trajectory, following discussions with client teams in Svalbard in April.

items.title: nero_eth：strawmap 的重点
items.note: 01:09：UX（更短 slot、frame 交易、更快最终性、隐私、代码大小上限提高、EVM 功能）、扩容（zkEVM、新状态类型、限制状态增长、VOPS 等新节点类型、新状态树、数据扩容与 gas limit 提升）以及 PQ/Lean。
items.title_en: nero_eth: what the strawmap focuses on
items.note_en: 01:09: UX (shorter slots, frame transactions, faster finality, privacy, code size increases, EVM features), scaling (zkEVMs, new types of state, limiting state growth, new node types such as VOPS, a new state trie, data scaling and gas limit increases) and PQ/Lean.

items.title: Barnabé：与 2 月原版对比
items.note: 16:59，quick slots 从 Hegotá 推迟到 J*，进一步缩短 slot 从 K* 推到 L*，decoupled consensus 列入 I*；他的三点概括 16:02：更快的最终性和区块、更高吞吐量、后量子。
items.title_en: Barnabé: compared with the February original
items.note_en: 16:59: quick slots move from Hegotá to J*, further slot time reductions from K* to L*, and decoupled consensus is slotted for I*; his three-point summary, 16:02: faster finality and blocks, more throughput, post-quantum.

items.title: dankrad：3 到 4 年太慢
items.note: 05:20，全证明的 STF、扩展到 Gigagas、秒级最终性令人兴奋，但应争取约 1 年完成，他认为借助 LLM 现实可行。
items.title_en: dankrad: 3 to 4 years is very slow
items.note_en: 05:20; a fully proven STF, scaling to Gigagas and finality in seconds are exciting, but the aim should be about a year, which he thinks is realistic now with LLMs.

summary_en: Vitalik published the updated Ethereum strawmap from a researcher meeting in Berlin two weeks earlier, following discussions with client teams in Svalbard in April. Barnabé compared it with the February version: quick slots move from Hegotá to J*, further slot reductions from K* to L*, and decoupled consensus is slotted for I*. nero_eth summed up its focus as UX (shorter slots, frame transactions, faster finality, privacy), scaling and post-quantum. dankrad said 3 to 4 years is too slow and about a year is realistic with LLMs.
